{{Quote|And you are prepared to accept our offer?''"<br />"''Oh yes. As Rikkar-Du himself pointed out, the old ways must sometimes adapt to new realities.''"<br />"''Serve us well, old man. You see the price paid by those who refuse.|[[Darth Kruhl]] and Kassek-Ka|<ref name="Legacy 13" />}}
'''Kassek-Ka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Codru-Ji]] clan leader. In [[137 ABY]], another clan head named [[Rikkar-Du]] was contacted by [[Darth Kruhl]] with a proposal of giving him power over the clans of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] if he submitted to the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] under [[Darth Krayt]]. At a meeting of the heads of the clans attended by Kassek-Ka, [[Rikkar-Du]] attempted to convince the other leaders that they must unite to oppose Imperial rule. Kassek-Ka protested the idea of an alliance under one leader, saying it was not of their old ways&mdash;plotting, kidnapping, and coups.<ref name="Legacy 13" />

After the meeting broke up, Rikkar-Du visited with his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Tassa]], and told her to go back to their tent with their son, [[Jassar]]. Some time after Rikkar-Du left for the temple and Jassar had run off from his mother, Kassek-Ka [[Death/Legends|killed]] Tassa. Darth Kruhl confronted Rikkar-Du over disclosing his offer. When Jassar tried to defend his father, Khrul killed him before [[Assassination on Munto Codru|assassinating]] Rikkar-Du, an action that Khrul and Kassek-Ka had agreed upon and a message about defying the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Kassek-Ka then confirmed he would accept Darth Khrul's offer and adapt to the new reality.<ref name="Legacy 13" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kassek-Ka appeared in [[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]. Due to the lettering of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] using all capital letters, it is unclear within the issue if the third "k" is capitalized.<ref name="Legacy 13" /> However, it is written as uppercase in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', in which the character is mentioned in Tassa's entry.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|223|Tassa}}</ref>
